create_dropout_layer: create a Dropout layer with probability p for regularizing neural network activations
use_dropout_forward: use the Dropout forward method to apply dropout to input tensor x during training
enable_inference_dropout: enable dropout during inference by setting apply_during_inference to True on the Dropout module
review_dropout_class: review the Dropout class that extends nn.Module with configurable dropout probability and inference mode
test_dropout_training: test the Dropout module to verify it applies F.dropout only when training or apply_during_inference is True
